sourceTitle: The Life of Horatio, Lord Nelson
description: "The Life of Horatio, Lord Nelson" by Robert Southey is a historical account written in the early 19th century. The book chronicles the life and illustrious career of Admiral Horatio Nelson, focusing on his early years at sea, formative experiences, and notable adventures that shaped him into one of Britain’s greatest naval heroes.
